title: 含理想运放的一阶电路：反馈支路中的 RC
statement: 图示电路中 u_s = ε(t) V（t = 0 时由 0 跳变为 1 V），R_1 = 10 kΩ，R_2 = 20 kΩ，C = 10 µF，运放为理想运放。t < 0 时电容不带电。
求电容电流的初值 i_C(0₊)、输出电压终值 u_o(∞)、时间常数 τ，以及 t = 0.2 s 时的 u_o。

questions.explain: 虚短：u_n = 0，i_1 = 1 V/10 kΩ = 0.1 mA。0₊ 时 u_C = 0，R_2 中无电流；虚断，i_1 全部流进电容：i_C(0₊) = 0.1 mA（此时 u_o(0₊) = u_n − u_C = 0）。
稳态时电容开路，电路是反相比例放大器：u_o = −(R_2/R_1)·u_s = −2 V。
u_s 置零后 n 点是虚地、输出端由运放强制，从电容两端看进去只有 R_2：τ = R_2·C = 20×10³ × 10×10⁻⁶ = 0.2 s。

hints: 虚短：反相输入端 n 是虚地，u_n = 0；虚断：流入运放输入端的电流为零。
u_o = u_n − u_C = −u_C，所以只要求出 u_C(t)。电容和 R_2 并联在 n 与 o 之间。
求 τ：电容两端（n、o）看进去，n 被虚地钉住，o 由运放输出决定，等效电阻就是 R_2。
solution: **1. 分析思路。** 虚短 u_n = 0，所以 i_1 = u_s/R_1 = 0.1 mA（t > 0 时恒定）。虚断：i_1 全部流入反馈支路，分到 C 和 R_2：i_1 = i_C + u_C/R_2。
这是一个电流源 i_1 = 0.1 mA 对 R_2 ∥ C 充电的电路，就像 R_2、C 并联接在恒流源上。
这正是一个一阶有源低通滤波器的阶跃响应：直流增益 −2，时间常数 R_{2}C。

en.title: First-order circuit with an ideal op-amp: RC in the feedback path
statement: In the circuit, u_s = ε(t) V (jumping from 0 to 1 V at t = 0), R_1 = 10 kΩ, R_2 = 20 kΩ, C = 10 µF, and the op-amp is ideal. The capacitor is uncharged for t < 0.
Find the initial capacitor current i_C(0+), the final output voltage u_o(∞), the time constant τ, and u_o at t = 0.2 s.

questions.explain: Virtual short: u_n = 0, i_1 = 1 V/10 kΩ = 0.1 mA. At 0+, u_C = 0 so R_2 carries no current; virtual open: all of i_1 flows into the capacitor, i_C(0+) = 0.1 mA (and u_o(0+) = u_n − u_C = 0).
In steady state the capacitor is open and the circuit is an inverting amplifier: u_o = −(R_2/R_1)·u_s = −2 V.
With u_s zeroed, n is a virtual ground and the output is forced by the op-amp; seen from the capacitor terminals only R_2 remains: τ = R_2·C = 20×10³ × 10×10⁻⁶ = 0.2 s.

hints: Virtual short: the inverting input n is a virtual ground, u_n = 0; virtual open: no current flows into the op-amp inputs.
u_o = u_n − u_C = −u_C, so you only need u_C(t). The capacitor and R_2 are in parallel between n and o.
For τ, look in from the capacitor terminals (n, o): n is pinned at virtual ground and o is set by the op-amp output, so the equivalent resistance is just R_2.
solution: **1. Approach.** Virtual short u_n = 0, so i_1 = u_s/R_1 = 0.1 mA (constant for t > 0). Virtual open: all of i_1 enters the feedback path and divides between C and R_2: i_1 = i_C + u_C/R_2.
So this is a current source i_1 = 0.1 mA charging R_2 ∥ C, just like R_2 and C in parallel across a constant current source.
**2. Initial values.** u_C(0+) = 0 → no current in R_2, **i_C(0+) = 0.1 mA**, u_o(0+) = 0 (the output doesn't jump).
**3. Final values.** Capacitor open: u_C(∞) = i_1·R_2 = 2 V, **u_o(∞) = −2 V** (inverting gain −R_2/R_1 = −2).
This is the step response of a first-order active low-pass filter: DC gain −2, time constant R_{2}C.
